notes: Grid: even columns sit half a hex lower (oddColumnsDown false). Label centre offset measured as -0.375 hex. Mapper (locally weighted homography, sigma 3) fitted on 101 label anchors found by template matching (rendered Liberation Sans labels, NCC) and checked by eye; residual max 5.9 px, rms 2.3 px.

Terrain: per-hex colour fractions (clear grey / tan hill / dark shading / blue) inside 85% of each fitted hex, then every hex checked on hex-by-hex contact sheets. Terrain is clear if clear > hill + dark, else hill; mountainShade if dark shading > 50% on.

Mountain hexsides: both sides of the hexside sampled 5 px off the printed line from 8% to 92% of its length; 1.0 dark coverage taken as mountain and every candidate (and every 0.3-0.95 case) checked by eye at 3-6x. No marsh, sea, airfields, ports or landmarks in this photo.

Rivers: blue hexsides found by colour within 6 px (and 15 px for offset ones), traced by eye; class from the navy-outline test (navy rim on both edges of the blue stroke: 100% of cross-sections on the lower Volturno and the key major-river sample, 0% on the key minor sample, 0-42% elsewhere where the adjacent hex line causes the hits).

Roads: every road traced by eye as a polyline in photo pixels (roads_traced.py), hexsides crossed computed from nearest hex centres, then every crossing checked on hexside contact sheets. Major = solid dark charcoal line; minor = cream line with dashed dark edges.

River courses: Volturno comes down the west side (3013/3114 .. 3120/3219), the Titerno-like tributary joins at 3216/3217 from Faicchio; the Calore runs from Benevento west past Torrecuso and Solopaca to the confluence at the 3120/3219/3220 vertex below Amorosi; below that the Volturno (major) flows west along 3120-3220, 3120-3121, 3020-3120, 3019-3020. The Tammaro rises at Sassinoro (3918/4018), runs south along the 39xx/40xx boundary and leaves east under the SoP box at 4022/4023; a river (probably the lower Tammaro) comes back from under the box along 4024-4025 and flows west into Benevento. The Sabato ("Sobato") comes from S2 past Altavilla Irpina into Benevento; the upper Calore comes from the S2 edge at Apice into Benevento; an unnamed branch runs from the Calore at 3525 west to near San Martino (3225/3326).

Cities/towns: only BENEVENTO is a city (major, bold capitals, grid symbol, white hex outline). All other places are towns (small circles). VPs: Alife 3214, Amorosi 3219, Benevento 3725 (all "1"), plus a cut-off VP circle at 3019.

Scripts in this folder: segrid.py (grid with the Italy parity/label offset), coarse*.py/ncc.py/fit.py (calibration), analyze.py/seclass.py (colour sampling), riverwidth.py/rw2.py/outline*.py/navy.py (river class), bline.py/zone.py (boundary line), roads_traced.py/roadsides.py (roads), build.py/finish.py (assembly), tile.py/hexsheet.py/sidesheet.py/sheet.py/zoom.py/crop.py/ovl.py (review images).
